summary: Spec 6 BABYSITTING (Jobby) — full end-to-end test PASSED. Backend: 25/25 pytest tests green (child-cards CRUD + consent/name/age gates, config, estimate, full persona_lf lifecycle from create → admin invite → provider generic-only incoming → propose → confirm (LF impegno nominale+1h margin) → confirmed-provider full visibility → incontro (Jitsi link) → inizio(4-digit code) → inizio/confirm → fine → invalid_code rejected → fine/confirm → consuntivo (billable_ore ≥ booked_ore min-guarantee) → completata → review, garanzia primo incontro refunds LF borsellino + fee, emergency returns 112/118 + parent_contact, provider profile/listino/casellario, admin casellario verify 12mo expiry, admin listing urgent-first with compatible providers). Frontend E2E via mobile viewport (390x844) also works: login bstest@jobby.app/test1234 → Home '🧸 Babysitting' card → /babysitting/configura wizard (children/when/where/ripetizioni/recurrence/summary steps navigation confirmed) → child creation modal enforces name + consenso toggle (consenso required before Salva succeeds) → configurator shows live estimate 'Stima: €44.95' in footer → Publish → /babysitting/[id] detail renders 'Richiesta inviata!', 'In pubblicazione', child card and 'In attesa di babysitter disponibili' with Annulla button → Richieste tab lists new request with 🧸 icon and 'Pubblicata' badge → Profile tab loads correctly. No crashes, no red screen, no console errors. Only non-blocking React Native web deprecation warnings observed (shadow* and props.pointerEvents).

Console warning: 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents'. Not from babysitting screens directly but shared UI components; consider fixing at UI layer.

action_items: Optional: migrate theme shadow.card to boxShadow to silence RN Web deprecation warnings.
Optional: replace pointerEvents prop with style.pointerEvents in shared UI components.

fine/confirm returns 400 invalid_code when non-empty wrong code is provided; empty code path allowed (implicit ok) — matches spec.
Emergency numbers 112 (Italian single European) + 118 (medical) present in config and endpoint response.
